summary.result: From test results, existence of the yield surfaces and an application of hardening laws to samples are confirmed by comparison between test and predicted results.
summary.background: The yield surface is formulated within the framework of hardening plasticity using two independent sets of stress variables : the excess of total stress over air pressure and the suction.
summary.method: Matric suction is controlled by the axis translation technique using high air entry ceramic disk.
